functions.name: reinforcing verbal noun in the accusative

rules.text: root identity with the governing verb, verbal-noun status, the question the noun answers and agreement with a definite holder are SUPPLIED evidence, never inferred from the surface accusative alone
all four roles share one surface signature (an indefinite accusative noun after a verb), so the case marking alone can never select a role

the motive role has hard preconditions: verbal-noun status, causal sense, one agent at one time, and indefiniteness; a failed precondition abstains, and the prepositional construction is the recorded repair
same root with a causal reading leaves reinforcement and motive both live: preserve alternatives rather than letting either test override the other
the state role requires a DEFINITE holder and an indefinite accusative descriptor; the respect role requires an identifiable vagueness to resolve
